skills.name: Writing about the rights and duties of the girl child

note.text:
To write a short expository text: a title; an introduction that says what you will write about; one paragraph on rights and one on duties, each with a topic sentence and examples; a conclusion that gives your opinion.
Linking words: first, also, in addition, however, finally, in conclusion.

worked_example.problem: Plan a text on the rights and duties of the girl child.
steps: Title: The rights and duties of the girl child.
Introduction: like every child, a girl has rights, and these rights come with duties.
First paragraph (rights): education, health, protection from violence and early marriage, to be heard.
Second paragraph (duties): respect, study, help at home, protect the environment.
Conclusion: when girls are protected and responsible, the whole community gains.

cards.idea: Each paragraph has one main idea and a topic sentence.
example: A girl child has important rights.

cards.idea: Give examples to support each idea.
example: For example, she has the right to go to school.

cards.idea: Use linking words: first, also, however, in conclusion.
example: In conclusion, rights and duties go together.

questions.prompt: Put the parts of the text in order.

items.text: The rights and duties of the girl child
Like every child, a girl has rights and duties.
First, a girl has the right to go to school and to be protected.
However, she also has duties: to respect others and to study hard.
In conclusion, rights and duties go together.

paper_task.prompt: Write a text of about 150 words in your exercise book: “The rights and duties of the girl child”. Give a title, an introduction, one paragraph on rights, one on duties and a conclusion.
model:
The rights and duties of the girl child

Like every child, a girl has rights, and these rights come with duties.

First, a girl has the right to go to school, just like a boy. She has the right to good health care and to be protected from violence and from early marriage. She also has the right to give her opinion on matters that concern her.

However, she also has duties. She must respect her parents, her teachers and her elders. She must study hard and help at home, and, like everybody, she must protect the environment.

In conclusion, when a girl's rights are respected and she carries out her duties, she grows into a responsible woman who helps her community.
checklist: My introduction says what the text is about.
One paragraph is about rights, with examples.
One paragraph is about duties, with examples.
I used linking words (first, also, however, in conclusion).
My sentences are correct and punctuated.
